title: savings-ledger — one row per request (draft v0)
description: DIRECTION.md §4.3 + §8.4 measurement honesty: the free count_tokens probe on the original body vs actually-billed usage, in the same row. Simultaneously the billing basis (Team), the upsell proof (Free→Pro), and the trust artifact (Enterprise).

counterfactual_input_tokens.description: count_tokens probe on the ORIGINAL (uncurated) request body — the only permitted baseline (§8.4). null = probe failed; never estimated.

billed_input_tokens.description: Actually-billed uncached input tokens from the upstream usage block.

cachePrefixSha8.description: Cache-bust attribution (§4.3, adopted from pxpipe): hash of the served conversation prefix.

fail_open.description: True when this request was served passthrough after an error (§8.3).

conv_id.description: Proxy conversation identity (hash-derived; no raw content).

model.description: The request's model id (a harness identifier, not content) — enables per-model reporting and honest dollarization via a price table (packages/bench pricing owns prices; the ledger stays token-denominated per §8.4).

session_id.description: Client harness session identity (Claude Code metadata.user_id session_id — an id, never content; the pattern is the contract-level guarantee). Groups requests across the conv_ids one session mints via compaction and subagents. Absent when the client sends no parseable session metadata.

checkpoint_id.description: sha256 of the brain checkpoint bundle that scored this request (capture seam: served-cut provenance). Absent on passthrough-only requests.

brain_ms.description: Wall time spent in brain scoring calls this request.

scorer_fail_opens.description: Birth steps left undecided this request because the scorer errored (§8.3 — counted, retried on a later call, never guessed).

freeze_cut_tokens.description: Estimated token mass of chunks the freezer dropped across the conversation so far (internal-view chars/4 units, NOT billed tokens — savings claims come only from the counterfactual).

tools_total.description: Tool schemas on the inbound request (pre-prune roster size; capture seam TRAINING_CAPTURE_GAPS #1).

tools_kept.description: Tool schemas actually forwarded after the frozen keep-set filter.

tools_pre_prune_sha8.description: Hash of the pre-prune roster (sorted names) — joins served traffic back to the full-roster identity without storing schemas.

tools_unfrozen.description: Pruned tools re-added to the keep-set THIS request because the prefix called them (reactive unfreeze) — present only on the request that unfroze them.

tools_stubbed.description: Pruned tools served as name+note stubs instead of hard-dropped (DASEIN_TOOL_STUB on) — present only when the stub path ran.

curator_insists.description: Insist-valve fires this request: the agent re-asked for content the curator had cut and the valve served it full — the per-request over-cut (regret) signal.

governor_mode.description: Governor seams (all gov_* fields + nbr_cost_median) are present only when DASEIN_GOVERNOR != off; pre-governor rows stay schema-identical. 'advise' = signals recorded, wire untouched; 'on' = directives may be injected.

gov_runaway_factor.description: billed input-side cumulative tokens / neighbour-cost median (rounded to 3 decimals); 0 = no opinion (hoods inert/unfetched).

gov_loop_frac.description: Latest loop_fracs value (rounded to 3 decimals); 0 when fewer than 6 commands exist (the reference gate).

gov_doom_q.description: Doom-head sigmoid on the 1e-6 grid for this request's trace scoring; absent when the doom head was not scored this request.

gov_n_src.description: Distinct non-test source files the agent's own actions edited (the BANK do-no-harm signal).

gov_cum_tok.description: Char-derived double-cumsum context tokens (governor._budget_features port, rounded to integer) — NOT billed tokens.

gov_rule_fires.description: Rule fires delivered (or, in advise mode, recorded) this turn after the (eid, fire_step) dedupe.

gov_directive_injected.description: True when a governor directive turn was actually appended to the served body this request (always false in advise mode).

nbr_cost_median.description: Neighbour-cost median from /v1/neighbors (billed-input-token denominated), cached per conversation; null = fetched but hoods inert (<4 cost-bearing neighbours). Absent until fetched.
